routes.name: Research-only, matched pilot horizon
routes.scope: One specified initial research edition/use route, no in-person event.
routes.event_count_basis: Definition of research-only route, not observed operations.
routes.core_common_work: Same selected edition and required research collection/production as B-PILOT; remove only genuinely incremental event work.
routes.cash_timing_note: Licence/partner/service receipts and fulfilment differ. Actual dates/status remain inputs, not immediate cash on expression of interest.
routes.core_commercial_route: Syndicated research with multiple standalone licence orders, without events; funding/briefing components may be combined only if actually selected and nonoverlapping.

routes.name: Event-supported, one-city UK pilot
routes.scope: Same defined research/use route plus one specified UK peer/research gathering, city/date to agree.
routes.core_common_work: Keep the common research base; add only incremental live-event/peer recruitment, preparation, hospitality/travel and follow-through work.
routes.cash_timing_note: Deposits and cancellation exposure may precede partner receipts. Confirmed/received funding is different from uncontracted expected sales.

routes.name: Research-only, matched annual horizon
routes.scope: Research editions and scoped services selected for the same annual window and research basis as B-ANNUAL; no in-person events.
routes.core_common_work: Same chosen research editions and necessary research collection as B-ANNUAL; no automatic future edition/update or renewal is implied.
routes.cash_timing_note: Recurring availability is not contracted recurring cash. Separate future renewal assumptions from actual orders.
routes.core_commercial_route: Syndicated research with multiple standalone licence orders, without events; funding/briefing components may be combined only if actually selected and nonoverlapping.

routes.name: Event-supported annual four-location option
routes.scope: Matched annual research basis plus proposed London, Manchester, Dublin and Texas-city-to-be-agreed events.
routes.event_count_basis: Original concept capacity, not booked/delivered events or a representative cohort.
routes.core_common_work: Each city has its actual incremental costs and receipts; common research/programme work counted once. Different city cohorts are not a longitudinal panel.
routes.cash_timing_note: Preserve GBP/EUR/USD amounts and actual/planning FX basis; Texas city and international travel assumptions remain unresolved.

revenue_lines.name: Standalone research-use licence
revenue_lines.unit: One defined edition/use-entitlement order, outside a funded or free equivalent entitlement.
revenue_lines.quantity_rule: Count only standalone actually specified units; a unique customer and its orders are different counts. Exclude equivalent free contributor use and rights already bundled in another order.
revenue_lines.earning_basis_to_define: Release/delivery of the agreed edition and actual rights/access; no accounting recognition policy adopted.

revenue_lines.name: Founding research partnership
revenue_lines.unit: One defined edition/purpose partnership order with a specified benefit bundle.
revenue_lines.quantity_rule: Count the package fee once. Do not add the notional value of included licence, briefing or recognition as separate sales.
revenue_lines.earning_basis_to_define: Record the actual report/briefing/recognition or other fulfilment obligations and their timing. Cash deposit/receipt is separate from fulfilment.
servicing: DW01 actual funded research/release work, if any

revenue_lines.name: Separately sold briefing or use preparation
revenue_lines.unit: One explicitly additional service or preparation order with a scoped audience/task/material.
revenue_lines.quantity_rule: Count only where genuinely additional, wanted and not already included in licence/partner/free entitlement. No automatic upsell or separate fee for agreed-scope defects.
revenue_lines.earning_basis_to_define: Actual agreed service/asset delivery, without importing unlimited inquiry or new research.
servicing: DW04 permitted public/client use if needed

revenue_lines.name: Separately defined event/access support, optional
revenue_lines.unit: One transparently specified event/access benefit package if appropriate and agreed.
revenue_lines.quantity_rule: Not in the core research proposition. A combined partner order remains one billed bundle unless an actually separate nonoverlapping order exists. No default meeting, identity or private-answer rights.
revenue_lines.earning_basis_to_define: Actual agreed permissible event/access benefits, delivery prerequisites and timing; not mere sponsor interest.

cost_objects.name: Current commissioned project investment
cost_objects.work: The existing USD1,500 engagement, with contract allocations USD1,000 report and USD500 Table.
cost_objects.allocation_rule: Initial identifiable project investment; classify once, retain original currency and actual status.
cost_objects.overlap_guardrail: Current commission is not a future edition unit-cost quote or proof of free future research.
cost_objects.status_boundary: Do not treat the full contract as irrevocably sunk or all paid: retain actual paid, remaining acceptance-triggered, committed and cancellable status from the agreement/records.

cost_objects.name: Future/common research production
cost_objects.work: Research design, collection/verification, coding, analysis, writing, graphics/editing and final checks for the actual selected editions.
cost_objects.allocation_rule: Common research basis shared between matched A/B comparisons; incremental event research work is separately identified.
cost_objects.overlap_guardrail: Do not charge the current commissioned production twice through another research-hours line.

cost_objects.name: Licence/customer servicing
cost_objects.work: Reading path, rights/use asset, bounded briefing if included, questions/corrections, sales and administration.
cost_objects.allocation_rule: Incremental order/service costs plus genuinely shared overhead allocated transparently.
cost_objects.overlap_guardrail: Same prepared asset or briefing cannot be costed twice merely because two package labels include it.

cost_objects.name: Member/research participation
cost_objects.work: Eligibility screening, scheduling, practical input, permission/output handling, moderation preparation and optional follow-through.
cost_objects.allocation_rule: Required research collection common to A/B where applicable; additional live-event/peer work marked incremental.
cost_objects.overlap_guardrail: Contributor count, membership interest and event attendance are not interchangeable workload units.

cost_objects.name: Event-specific direct operations
cost_objects.work: Venue/private-room terms, food/drink, service/taxes, access, travel/accommodation, on-site moderation/hosts/admin and cancellation exposure.
cost_objects.allocation_rule: Per-event incremental cost; sum actual city/date/seat line objects, with separately identified shared programme work.
cost_objects.overlap_guardrail: A menu price is not necessarily a room minimum, and host/sponsor seats are not free merely because practitioner seats are free.

cost_objects.name: JGA time and operating resources
cost_objects.work: Research oversight, recruitment, sales, hosting, governance and administration hours by role and work object.
cost_objects.allocation_rule: Distinguish incremental cash labour from existing staff opportunity/allocation time; value time in full-resource view.
cost_objects.overlap_guardrail: No unpaid founder time silently disappears; no same labour hours counted as cash expense and added again as opportunity cost.

cost_objects.name: Other implementation and commercial costs
cost_objects.work: Payment/FX fees, necessary insurance/other operating items, refund/cancellation and contingency appropriate to actual model.
cost_objects.allocation_rule: Record applicable basis, cash timing and inclusion/overlap; contingency basis explicit.
cost_objects.overlap_guardrail: Do not add blanket buffers repeatedly over amounts already containing the same allowance.

comparison_rules: Use the same reporting horizon and core research/edition basis for each matched A/B comparison.
Model initial edition/pilot and a comparable annual programme separately; never compare a one-month A with a full-year B.
If annual routes share one research edition, count its production once; if additional editions/refreshes are selected, add their actual incremental work explicitly. No cadence assumed.
Separate current committed/paid investment, future avoidable operations, full resource cost and investment-recovery views.
Do not assign research sales to dinners automatically. Begin with explicit common demand assumptions; model event-related revenue differences only as separately labelled untested changes.
No current customer, partner, price, entitlement or available staffing is established by any route record.
